defsZh: a. 狂熱的, 熱心的, 熱烈的

examples.en: George is very enthusiastic about his new job.
examples.zh: 喬治對自己的新工作充滿熱情。

examples.en: This book is a result of his enthusiastic research.
examples.zh: 這本書是他熱心研究的成果。

examples.en: My older brother is a very enthusiastic soccer fan.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥是很狂熱的足球迷。

defsEn: having or showing great excitement and interest

defsZh:
n. 畢業, 得學位, 分劃, 刻度, 分等級
[醫] 刻度, 分度, 畢業

examples.en: I've been really busy with my graduation dissertation recently.
examples.zh: 我最近真忙於我的畢業論文。

examples.en: From graduation to retirement, Laowang worked as a teacher without intermission.
examples.zh: 從大學畢業到退休，老王一直擔任教學工作。

examples.en: Although his exam scores weren't very high, he was still successful after graduation.
examples.zh: 儘管他考試成績不高，但他畢業後還是很成功。

defsEn: the successful completion of a program of study

defsZh: a. 冰的, 冰冷的, 冷淡的, 滑溜的

examples.en: The icy road sparkled in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 結冰的道路在陽光下閃閃發亮。

examples.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
examples.zh: 冰冷的疾風吹到我骨子裡去了。

examples.en: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.
examples.zh: 在結冰的街道上我們很難保持平衡。

defsEn: devoid of warmth and cordiality; expressive of unfriendliness or disdain

defsZh:
n. 不規則物, 不合規格之物
a. 不規則的, 不整齊的, 不合法的

examples.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡學習不規則動詞。

defsEn: a member of an irregular armed force that fights a stronger force by sabotage and harassment

defsZh: [計] 註冊(程式), 登記, 使用者註冊程式

a. 管理的
[經] 管理上的, 經營上的

examples.en: My classmate, Xiao Ming, has strong managerial capability.
examples.zh: 小明同學管理能力很強。

defsEn: of or relating to the function or responsibility or activity of management

defsZh:
n. 礦物, 無機物, 蘇打水
a. 礦物的, 似礦物的

examples.en: I like to drink natural mineral water.
examples.zh: 我喜歡喝天然的礦泉水。

examples.en: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.
examples.zh: 水果富含維生素和礦物質。

examples.en: That country is rich in mineral resources.
examples.zh: 那個國家擁有豐富的礦物資源。

defsEn: solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition

defsZh:
n. 摩托車
[機] 機動車, 機踏車, 摩托車

examples.zh: 她騎摩托車的技術不錯！

defsEn: a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame

defsZh:
n. 需要, 必需品, 必然
[法] 必要性, 必然性, 必要

examples.en: A computer is an absolute necessity now.
examples.zh: 電腦現在是一個絕對必要的東西了。

examples.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
examples.zh: 勞動不僅是一種需要，而還是一種愉快。

defsEn: the condition of being essential or indispensable

defsZh:
n. 計劃者, 設計者, 安排者
[機] 刨床機

defsZh:
n. 程式設計師
[計] 程式設計員; 程式設計師

examples.zh: 她是個女程式設計師嗎？

defsEn: a person who designs and writes and tests computer programs

defsZh: vt. 校正, 校對
defsEn: read for errors

defsZh: n. 招聘人員, 徵兵人員

examples.en: Jim was in touch with ISIS recruiters.

defsEn: someone who supplies members or employees

defsZh:
n. 剩餘物, 其他人, 殘餘, 餘數
v. 削價出售(圖書)
a. 剩餘的, 出售削價剩書的
[計] 餘數

examples.en: The remainder of the evening was peaceful.
Yanni scraped off the remainder of the resin.
He was excused from the remainder of the work.

defsEn: something left after other parts have been taken away

defsZh:
vt. 以雕像裝飾
n. 雕像

examples.en: We made statues out of wood.
This statue is as large as life.
examples.zh: 這座雕像和真人的尺寸一樣。

examples.en: He carved a Buddha statue from wood.
examples.zh: 他用一塊木頭刻出一尊佛像。

defsEn: a sculpture representing a human or animal

defsZh: adv. 穩定地, 無變化地, 有規則地

examples.zh: 這個病人正在穩定地康復中。
價格一直在穩定地攀升。

defsEn: at a steady rate or pace

defsZh:
n. 股東
[法] 股東, 股票持有者, 股票所有人

examples.en: I'm a stockholder in this company.
The stockholders are making money hand over fist.

defsEn: someone who holds shares of stock in a corporation

defsZh:
a. 空的, 空白的, 空虛的, 空閒的, 茫然的, 空缺的
[法] 空的, 空虛的, 閒暇的

examples.en: There were several rooms still vacant.
He was standing there with a vacant look.
Rooms should be left vacant by eleven a.m. on the day of departure.
examples.zh: 走的那天，房間11點要空出來。

defsEn: void of thought or knowledge

defsZh:
n. 附件, 零件, 附加物, 從犯, 同謀
a. 附屬的, 補充的, 同謀的, 幫兇的, 非主要的, 副的
[計] 附件

examples.en: Do you sell coffee pot accessories too?
examples.zh: 你們也有販售咖啡壺配件嗎？

defsEn: clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing

defsZh:
n. 與會者, 集會, 裝配, 元件
[化] 裝配

examples.en: Tessa shared her experience in a chapel assembly this April.
examples.zh: 今年四月，苔絲在教會集會上分享了她的經驗。

defsEn: a group of machine parts that fit together to form a self-contained unit

defsZh:
n. 籃, 籃子
vt. 裝入籃

examples.en: The eggs are in the basket.
The basket was full of apples.
She had a basket full of apples.

defsEn: a container that is usually woven and has handles

defsZh:
n. 證明
[經] 證明

examples.en: You can skip stage three of the certification process and advance immediately to stage six.
examples.zh: 您可以跳過認證過程的第三階段，直接進入第六階段。

examples.en: Do you have any work-related certifications?

defsEn: the act of certifying or bestowing a franchise on

defsZh:
n. 關閉
vt. 使終止

examples.en: The school's closure was due to the snow.
We hope that there is closure.
There is a road closure up ahead.

defsEn: approaching a particular destination; a coming closer; a narrowing of a gap

defsZh:
n. 嫌惡
vt. 討厭, 不喜歡

defsZh:
n. 樓下
a. 樓下的
adv. 在樓下
defsEn: on or of lower floors of a building

defsZh:
n. 終止, 滿期, 撥出, 呼氣
[醫] 呼[氣], 斷氣, 死亡

Every difficulty has an expiration date.

defsEn: a coming to an end of a contract period

defsZh:
n. 頭痛, 令人頭痛之事
[醫] 頭痛
defsEn: something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness

defsZh:
n. 果醬, 擁塞之物, 堵塞, 困境
vt. 擠進, 使塞滿, 混雜, 壓碎, 使堵塞
vi. 堵塞, 軋住, 擁擠

examples.en: She made jam from the apples.
She used apples to do the jam.

defsEn: preserve of crushed fruit

defsZh:
n. 釘子, 指甲
vt. 用釘釘牢, 使固定, 截住, 揭露

examples.zh: 這個釘子撕破了他的夾克。

defsEn: horny plate covering and protecting part of the dorsal surface of the digits

defsZh: a. 樂觀的, 樂觀主義的, 樂天的
defsEn: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds

defsZh:
n. 行人, 步行者
a. 人行的, 徒步的, 呆板的, 通俗的, 平淡無奇的

examples.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
The interface of this website is somewhat pedestrian, but it’s simple.
examples.zh: 這個網站的介面沒有甚麼新意，但是卻很簡潔。

examples.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
examples.zh: 當時正是早高峰，來來往往的行人和車輛很多。

defsEn: a person who travels by foot

defsZh:
n. 發射, 計劃, 突出部分, 設計, 推測
[計] 投影

examples.en: Sami has never seen a projection room.
Tom claims he can do astral projection.
What projection is this planisphere in?

defsEn: a prediction made by extrapolating from past observations

defsZh:
n. 袖子, 套管
vt. 縫上袖子

defsZh: n. 市郊住宅區, 郊區, 邊緣

examples.en: He lives in the suburbs of Tokyo.

defsEn: a residential district located on the outskirts of a city

defsZh:
n. 接管, 接收
[經] 接收

examples.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
examples.zh: 我們ACME有限公司，特此宣佈，我們將盡我們的力量抵制這種惡意收購。

examples.en: It's not a judicial reform; it's a judicial takeover.
Predictably, after Elon Musk's takeover, Twitter was flooded with Nazi spam.

defsEn: a sudden and decisive change of government illegally or by force

defsZh: a. 不肯定的, 不確定的, 沒有自信的

examples.en: She seemed somewhat unsure of herself.
examples.zh: 她似乎對自己有點不確定。

examples.en: He was unsure how he would get there, and when.
examples.zh: 他不知道怎麼到那裡去、什麼時候到。

defsEn: lacking self-confidence

defsZh:
a. 樓上的
adv. 在樓上, 向樓上, 處於更高地位
n. 樓層
defsEn: on or of upper floors of a building

defsZh:
a. 用言辭的, 言語的, 口頭的, 逐字的, 動詞的
[醫] 言語的, 口述的

examples.en: I don't need your verbal gentleness.
examples.zh: 我不需要你口頭上的溫柔。

examples.en: He opened up the verbal battle.

defsEn: communicated in the form of words

defsZh:
n. 簽證
vt. 簽發

examples.en: I beg you, give me a visa.
examples.zh: 拜託您，請給我一張簽證。

defsEn: an endorsement made in a passport that allows the bearer to enter the country issuing it

defsZh: n. 野生動植物

examples.en: When the World Wildlife Fund was founded in 1961, it took the panda as its symbol.
examples.zh: 國際野生動物基金在一九六一年創辦的時候，以熊貓為象徵。

defsEn: all living things (except people) that are undomesticated
